[EN] The Vanguard Initiative pulled as many soldiers as we could spare. We're here to find answers and give the Valkyon Federation a foothold in Northern Arun.

I knew it might prove costly, but I didn't think so many would die so soon.
[ES] La Vanguard Initiative reunió a tantos soldados como pudimos prescindir. Estamos aquí para encontrar respuestas y darle a la Valkyon Federation un punto de apoyo en Northern Arun.

Sabía que podría resultar costoso, pero no pensé que tantos morirían tan pronto.
